purpose: Temporary migration ceiling. Existing third-party runtime dependencies may only decrease; no new runtime dependency may be introduced.
rule: package.json dependencies must be a subset of this list until the list reaches empty. New entries are forbidden. Source-import ceilings are one-way migration guards: counts/files may only decrease.

@react-three/fiber.rule: R3F source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

@react-three/drei.rule: Drei source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

zustand.rule: Direct Zustand source imports are zero and may not return.

react.rule: React source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

react-dom.rule: ReactDOM source imports are zero and the package is removed. It may not return.

three.rule: Three is isolated behind one project-wide vendor gateway. No feature module may import it directly; this final import is removed only when the first-party scene/skinning/renderer runtime replaces the gateway.
